info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Investment Portfolio Dividends-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to detailed information about dividends associated with investment portfolios. Users can retrieve a comprehensive list of dividends, enabling portfolio management and investment decision-making. Typically utilized by financial analysts, portfolio managers, and investors, this endpoint supports effective tracking of income generated from investments. The API serves as a critical resource for evaluating performance and optimizing investment strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about the dividends associated with their investment portfolio, providing insights into income generated from investments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the dividend information for a specific portfolio. Ensure that the request adheres to the schema defined to facilitate proper processing.

200.description: Returns a list of dividend records successfully.
